summary: Preserve that rebinding local exports does not replace module.exports.

target.notes: exports is an ordinary wrapper-local initialized from module.exports; rebinding changes only the local.

caveats: exports = value is not shorthand for module.exports = value.

tests.name: original module exports remains
tests.input:
// a.cjs: module.exports.a=1; exports={b:2}
// main.cjs: const x=require('./a'); console.log(x.a,x.b);
